component.name: Gnome AI Chat
component.summary: Chat with local AI models via Ollama

description.p: Gnome AI Chat is a native GTK 4 and Libadwaita desktop client for chatting with local language models through Ollama. Conversations, settings, memory, and search indexes stay on your machine in a local SQLite database.
Key features:

ul.li: Native GNOME interface with GTK 4, Libadwaita, adaptive dialogs, and dark/light themes.
Local model detection, in-app model pulling with progress, running model inspection, and configurable reasoning levels.
Built-in tools (web search, page fetching, file search, shell, memory, HTML preview) and external MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP, with a built-in catalog of public servers.
Granular tool controls with Ask, Auto-accept, and Deny permissions per category and per server, plus individual tool switches.
Custom @skills with a dedicated Markdown editor, separate Main Agent and Sub-agents profiles, and task delegation to skills in isolated contexts.
Offline RAG to index local folders and chat with your own code and documents, plus image, screenshot, and text file attachments.
Multi-step web research via /deepsearch with numbered citations, clickable sources, live tool call status, and per-message generation stats.
Semantic search across past conversations, in-conversation find, slash commands, pinned chats, native Markdown tables, and duplicate-free JSON import/export.

description.p: This release adds import and export of chats, with a merge that never creates duplicates.

ul.li: Added an export of all chats to a single file, from the Data page in Settings or with /export.
Added an import that merges chats: missing chats are added, and a chat you already have is replaced only by a more recent version.
The JSON export of a single chat can now be imported back, and files exported by earlier versions still work.
Fixed an error message shown when cancelling an export.

description.p: This release adds agent profiles, skills that run as sub-agents, and finer control over tools.

ul.li: Added Main Agent and Sub-agents profiles in Settings, under Tools, to choose which built-in tools, MCP servers and skills each one gets.
The model can now hand a task to a skill that works in its own context and returns only its answer, which keeps long conversations lighter.
A skill can use its own set of built-in tools and MCP servers instead of the agent's.
Skills can be turned off without deleting them.
Each tool of an MCP server can be turned off from the server's Overview tab.
Built-in skills added by an update now appear in existing installations.
The Skills and MCP Servers windows share the same layout and shortcuts.
Fixed tool results being sent to the model twice.

description.p: This release adds control over built-in tools, a catalog of MCP servers, and modern dialogs that adapt to narrow windows.

ul.li: Added a Tools page in Settings to turn built-in tools on or off, one by one or by group.
Added a catalog of ready-to-use MCP servers that need no API key.
Skills are now picked with a round Skill button next to the attach button.
Settings, About and Pull Model now open as dialogs that adapt to narrow windows.
Tooltips are clearer and more consistent.
Fixed Regenerate on a reply that had just been generated, and the message menu on right-click.
Fixed the license shown in the About dialog and several smaller issues.

description.p: This release adds deep web research, clearer answers with their sources and details, and a reworked find in conversation.

ul.li: Added /deepsearch, which plans web searches, reads the best pages and writes a report with numbered citations.
Added a web_search tool that works without any setup.
Answers now show the files and web pages they used as sources, and a details button shows the model, speed and token counts.
Tool calls are shown live with their status and duration.
Find in conversation highlights every match in the text, including code blocks, and steps through them one by one.
Conversations can be renamed and pinned to the top of the sidebar.
Follow-up questions after a deep search keep the report and its sources.
Fixed Markdown rendering while streaming, regenerating commands, and several data loss issues on database errors.

description.p: This release adds Model Context Protocol servers and keeps long conversations within the model's context window.

ul.li: Added an MCP Servers window to register stdio and Streamable HTTP servers whose tools are offered to the model, with a dedicated permission category and per-server overrides.
Added the /mcp command to manage and reload servers, with automatic reconnection when a server drops.
Requests now fit the context window: the oldest messages are left out first and long tool results are shortened, while the system prompt and current message are always kept.
Tool calls are limited to 10 rounds per response and run one at a time when they need permission or change something.
A warning now appears when the selected model does not support tools or images in use.

description.p: This release restores model update notifications and makes skill activation more visible and reliable.

ul.li: Fixed the model update banner never appearing because the Ollama registry changed its digest header.
Fixed the model list not refreshing after pulling a model while the app was already running; newly pulled models are now selected automatically.
Added an active skill indicator in the input toolbar and validation of skill names in the Skills editor.
Fixed skill mentions being ignored when files were attached and prefix collisions between similarly named skills.

description.p: This release strengthens control over model tool usage with a richer permission system and fixes reasoning levels for gpt-oss models.

ul.li: Added a Deny tier to tool permissions alongside Ask and Auto-accept; denied tools are hidden from the model entirely.
Added new File Reads and Applications permission categories covering file reading, directory listing, file search, and app launching.
Fixed reasoning levels (low/medium/high) being ignored for tagged gpt-oss model ids.
Improved chat responsiveness by caching model capability lookups instead of fetching them on every turn.

description.p: This release introduces a native GNOME Shell extension for desktop integration.

ul.li: Added a native GNOME Shell extension supporting GNOME Shell 45 through 51.
Added a status indicator in the top panel and a global keyboard shortcut (default Super+i) to toggle the chat window.
Added npm scripts to build, install, and enable the extension locally.
Fixed D-Bus actions so New Conversation and Quit work from the panel menu.

description.p: This release adds D-Bus activation so notifications and desktop actions can launch the app from a cold start.

ul.li: Added D-Bus activation support to the desktop launcher and Flatpak configuration.
Updated application startup to handle incoming actions cleanly when the app is closed.

description.p: This release fixes a database initialization race condition at startup.

ul.li: Deferred loading performance stats until after database tables are created, fixing a startup error in sandboxed environments.

description.p: This release updates Flatpak packaging for Flathub and fixes desktop and AppStream validation warnings.

ul.li: Added offline npm cache support to the Flatpak manifest for sandboxed builds.
Updated AppStream developer metadata and desktop entry fields to pass validation cleanly.

description.p: This release improves code streaming, adds PDF export and image saving, and streamlines desktop permissions.

ul.li: Eliminated code block flickering while streaming responses.
Forwarded attached screenshots and files automatically during tool-call sequences.
Added PDF export for conversations and a right-click option to save chat images.
Removed autonomous desktop automation and screenshots in favor of user-initiated attachments.

description.p: This release adds a Regenerate action, RSS feed parsing, and improvements to slash commands and file attachments.

ul.li: Added a Regenerate response action to re-submit prompts.
Added an RSS feed tool for parsing RSS and Atom feeds natively.
Expanded /hn with best, newest, and custom search subcommands.
Added /files attach (fuzzy path search) and /files search (local semantic search).
Fixed slash command argument parsing and disabled summarization on empty conversations.

description.p: This release fixes startup race conditions and speeds up local file search.

ul.li: Fixed startup race conditions so rapid actions wait for the database to load and never overwrite conversations.
Improved local file search performance and raised the result limit to 50.

description.p: This release adds native Markdown tables, cleaner slash commands, and faster database writes.

ul.li: Added native Markdown table rendering using Gtk.ColumnView with live updates while streaming.
Hid internal navigation shortcuts from the slash command menu.
Wrapped bulk database writes in atomic transactions and moved vector indexing to the background.
Fixed memory leaks in messages, Settings, and the Skills window.
Refined built-in skill prompts with clearer tool usage rules for Writer, Reviewer, Canvas, Coder, Files, and Memory.

description.p: This release moves local data to SQLite and adds semantic skill search.

ul.li: Migrated conversations, settings, skills, and memory from JSON files to a local SQLite database.
Added semantic matching for skills using local text embeddings.
Auto-attached captured screenshots directly to the chat input.
Improved code block parsing and kept skill prompts consistent across multi-step tool calls.

description.p: This release adds local folder RAG and tool execution permissions.

ul.li: Added local RAG to index project folders in SQLite and query them with @files.
Added approval prompts and permission settings for shell commands and file edits.
Added UI in Settings to manage and re-index local folders.
Switched screenshot capture to native Wayland portals.

description.p: This release fixes syntax highlighting updates during streaming.

ul.li: Fixed code block syntax highlighting not updating when reusing widgets while streaming.

description.p: This release introduces a dedicated Skills Editor window.

ul.li: Added a dedicated Skills Editor window with a syntax-highlighted Markdown editor and sidebar search.
Grouped skills into Built-ins and Custom sections with per-skill reset buttons.
Added the /skills slash command and auto-triggered @memory for /memory subcommands.
Fixed an out-of-bounds crash when navigating images with the keyboard.
Aligned system prompt editor styling and margins in the skill dialog.

description.p: This release adds image previews, model update notifications, and capability awareness.

ul.li: Added full-size image preview with slideshow navigation.
Added Markdown syntax highlighting in the skill prompt editor.
Added model update notifications with a one-click Update button.
Detected vision and tool capabilities per model to disable unsupported actions.

description.p: Major feature release adding auto-summarized titles, attachments, HTML Canvas, and slash commands.

ul.li: Added background conversation title and emoji generation.
Added text file and screenshot attachments, plus interactive HTML Canvas previews.
Added an in-app Model Pull dialog with live progress and cancellation.
Added /hn, /memory, /compress, and /debug slash commands and appearance themes.
